name: Sketchpad
summary: Ivan Sutherland's TX-2 interactive light-pen drawing system whose master drawings and instances, ring-structured data and constraint satisfaction anticipated object-oriented and constraint programming; a visual specification system rather than a textual language.

level_notes.0: The TX-2 program does not survive in runnable form.
level_notes.2: Secondary literature is mostly in histories of graphics; Wikipedia summarises it.
level_notes.1: Sutherland's 1963 MIT thesis (reissued as Cambridge TR-574) is the defining document.
